name: Paul
note: The apostle (in the traditional view), writing to his younger co-worker and remembering his own past as a violent opponent shown mercy (1:12-16).

name: Timothy
note: Paul's "true child in faith" (1:2), left in Ephesus, young (4:12), with a gift received through prophecy and the laying on of hands (4:14).

name: Hymenaeus and Alexander
note: Two men who rejected faith and a good conscience and "made shipwreck"; Paul handed them over to Satan "that they might be taught not to blaspheme" (1:19-20).

name: The false teachers
note: Those teaching different doctrine, occupied with myths, endless genealogies, and arguments about the law (1:3-7; 4:1-3; 6:3-5).

name: Christ Jesus
note: "The one mediator between God and men" (2:5), who came into the world to save sinners (1:15).

name: Adam and Eve
note: Referred to in 2:13-14 in a debated passage about teaching and authority.

name: Overseers and deacons
note: Leaders whose qualities are listed in 3:1-13.

name: Widows
note: Those the church should honor and support, with careful guidance about who is truly in need (5:3-16).

name: Elders
note: Leaders worthy of double honor, who are not to be accused lightly (5:17-25).

name: The rich in this age
note: Told not to be arrogant or trust in riches but to be rich in good works (6:17-19).

name: Pontius Pilate
note: Before whom Christ Jesus "witnessed the good confession" (6:13).
